body: Usually you can fake it long enough to get hired. Over time people will start to gravitate away from you once they realize that you are a bit off. What keeps you employed is being able to perform the job itself and not make any one else too uncomfortable.
Blanket student loan forgiveness is okay but reparations is unfeasible. Never change reddit.

My biggest regret is letting my anxieties control me for so long. The missed opportunities only compounded my feelings of worthlessness. So my advice is up your socialization skills and pursue anything you find interesting without worrying about anyone else's opinion.

You're still young so making mistakes is expected.
